text:
Maya Rao: Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A thread. I'm dropping notes, links and the action list here. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/3081234567

Maya Rao: Summary: Dedicated GA window = Q3 (narrower dates in product plan), Private pilot = limited customer cohort this year, pricing + SLA drafts are in progress. I'll keep the owners assigned below.

Sanjay Patel: Runtime kernels question from infra: will advanced attention kernels be enabled by default at GA?

Maya Rao: @Sanjay core kernel improvements will be included at GA; experimental optimizations (attention fusion variants) will roll out in minor releases after GA with opt-in toggles.

Kristin Lee: I'm taking pricing. Will publish a short PRD with example rate cards and FAQ for sales by next Wednesday.

Dario Gomez: SLA specifics: can we get target uptime & latency numbers so SRE can build tests?

Maya Rao: Draft targets: Dedicated = 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; model-class SLOs for 50th/95th latency. @Dario can you formalize the wording + escalation path?

Dario Gomez: Yes, I'll put a draft in #eng-sre and link back. ETA: Monday COB.

Ezra Chen: For model upgrades we said we'd provide regression eval sets for customers. I'll assemble initial datasets and a how-to for running them. ETA: Friday.

Sanjay Patel: For Dedicated vs Private: will customers be able to request fixed rack placement?

Maya Rao: Rack pinning is Private-only. Dedicated will offer placement and affinity controls but not guaranteed physical rack reservation at GA.

Kristin Lee: Sales ask: will there be ramp discounts for committed capacity? Need examples for AE playbooks.

Maya Rao: Yes — committed-month/annual tiers with discounts. @Kristin include examples in the PRD.

Sanjay Patel: Who owns quantization guidance and perf/quality tradeoffs?

Ezra Chen: Research will own a short quant playbook; I'll work with @Sanjay to publish recommended configs per model family + measured deltas.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New page created: https://notion.redwood/ops/sla-draft (created by Dario Gomez) :white_check_mark:

Maya Rao: Action owners (quick):
- Kristin Lee: Pricing PRD + sample rate cards + AE FAQ (ETA next Wed)
- Dario Gomez: SLA doc, escalation path, canary checklist (ETA Mon COB)
- Ezra Chen: Regression eval sets + quant playbook (ETA Fri)
- Sanjay Patel: Kernel compatibility matrix + known runtime limitations (ETA next Thu)
- Maya Rao: Publish consolidated all-hands Q&A doc (ETA EOD Mon)

Kristin Lee: I'll also create a short sales cheat-sheet for Early Access.

Sanjay Patel: I'll add a limitations list in the matrix and note feature flags for experimental kernels.

Ezra Chen: Looking for a pilot customer for regression evals. @Kristin do we have volunteers?

Kristin Lee: One mid-market customer expressed interest; I'll make an intro and loop you in privately.

Dario Gomez: Canary checklist draft (I'll paste in eng-sre doc):
```
canary checklist:
- route 1% traffic to new runtime
- monitor 95th latency and error rate
- rollback if request errors increase >0.5% or 95th latency regresses >15%
```

Maya Rao: If owners need to adjust ETAs or want to add items, reply here. I'll freeze the consolidated Q&A doc at EOD Monday. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
